conceptZh: 糕：米加羔，鬆軟的米糕或蛋糕。
object: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, and a cherry-topped layer cake that dodges
morph: the cake keeps hopping away from sword swings, each miss flinging a frosting stroke, until the warrior flips his shield into a plate
creativeAngle: 玩具戰士追砍會逃跑的蛋糕，砍空的奶油變成筆畫，最後用盾牌當盤子才接住。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean 2D/3D toy-animation clip. Teaching subject: the single Traditional Chinese glyph 糕 (cake), correctly formed, in a saturated solid color against a much lighter background, ending centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with margins. Lead cast: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, and a cherry-topped layer cake that dodges. Soft peach-pink backdrop with a pastel tabletop strip; the glyph is raspberry-pink with cream highlights. Timed beats. 0.0-1.5s: a chunky toy warrior in a dented helmet charges in with a foam sword and round shield, bravely roaring in silence. The voice says the first 糕 as a little layer cake on a stand hops up from the right and hops away from him. 1.5-3.0s: swing, miss, swing, miss; the cake bounces over the sword each time and each near-hit flicks a ribbon of pink frosting that sticks in the air as a stroke. The voice says the second 糕 as the warrior spins in dizzy circles. 3.0-4.5s: the cake sneers (a cheeky tongue) and jumps high; the warrior outsmarts it by flipping his shield flat like a plate and catching it, the last frosting stroke dropping to complete 糕 at 70% of frame height. 4.5-5.0s: the voice says 蛋糕 (ㄉㄢˋ ㄍㄠ) as the cherry-topped cake lands on the shield and the warrior hoists it overhead. Final hold: 5.0-8.0s: the glyph stays still; the warrior tips his helmet while the cake gives a little shiver off to the side. The glyph holds fully still and clearly readable for the last 3 seconds. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen narrator speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin (Taiwan standard readings, no erhua), reading exactly these syllables with clear tones: 糕、糕、蛋糕 (ㄍㄠ、ㄍㄠ、ㄉㄢˋ ㄍㄠ). Say the character twice with a short pause, then the word once, and stop; no other speech, subtitles or loud music. The vocabulary word is audio only. The glyph 糕 is the only text on screen: no subtitles, captions, labels, watermark, logos, clutter, flashing or strobing effects, and no real people or realistic human figures; all characters are stylized toys or cartoon animals.

conceptZh: 拉布拉多警長看到一座巨大的多層蛋糕擋在路中間，吹哨助跑卻踩到奶油滑過頭，第二次後仰蓄力全速衝撞，「碰」地撞進蛋糕，震落的米粒、奶油層和四根小蠟燭火苗掉下來排成「糕」字，警長壓扁扁地暈著傻笑。
object: a huge pastel multi-layer toy cake blocking the road like a wall, with rice-grain sprinkles on its left half and four lit birthday candles on top
morph: the sheriff's BONK shakes the giant cake: rice-grain sprinkles rain down and stack into the 米 radical on the left, frosting layers drop into the 羊 top of the right side, and the four candle flames fall in a row as the four 灬 dots underneath, completing 糕
creativeAngle: 前一版是玩具戰士追砍會躲的蛋糕，這次改成「衝撞」模式：拉布拉多警長把巨大蛋糕當成路障要清除，先滑過頭、再全速撞上，撞擊本身震落米粒、奶油層與四根蠟燭火苗組成「糕」（米＋羊＋灬），字形的每個部件都對應蛋糕的具體零件，而且四個火苗點剛好就是底下四點。「蛋糕」一詞說出時，一個小杯子蛋糕掉到警長頭上，聲音與畫面同步。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip in soft 3D with chunky cartoon shapes. Teaching subject: the single Traditional Chinese glyph 糕 (cake), correctly formed, drawn in solid raspberry-red strokes on a pale butter-yellow background, ending centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with clean margins. Lead: a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog, golden fur, oversized tin star badge, a whistle on a cord, eager and over-confident. Supporting prop: one enormous pastel multi-layer toy cake standing across the road like a wall, its left half covered in rice-grain sprinkles, four lit birthday candles on top. Only these two things on screen, flat road, nothing busy behind.

0.0-1.5s: the sheriff slides in from the left, spots the giant cake blocking the road, and points at it with a stern paw. He blows his whistle (a soft toot), digs his back feet into the ground and leans way back in a huge wind-up. The voice says the first 糕 as he leans.
1.5-3.0s: he charges at full speed, but steps on a blob of frosting and skids right past the cake, legs windmilling, off the right edge of frame. A beat of empty road, then he pokes his head back in, ears flopping, embarrassed.
3.0-4.5s: bigger wind-up: he backs up further, tail spinning like a propeller, holds one frozen beat of anticipation, then rockets straight into the cake with a big squashy BONK. The whole cake wobbles like jelly. The impact shakes everything loose: rice-grain sprinkles rain down and stack into the 米 radical on the left, frosting layers drop down into the 羊 shape at the top right, and the four candle flames fall in a neat row to become the four dots 灬 beneath it. The voice says the second 糕 exactly as the last flame-dot snaps into place and 糕 stands complete at 70% of frame height.
4.5-5.5s: the sheriff peels off the cake flattened like a pancake, pops back to shape, and wobbles dizzily with a big goofy grin, his badge spinning. The voice says 蛋糕 (ㄉㄢˋ ㄍㄠ) exactly as one small cherry-topped slice of cake drops from above and lands squarely on his head like a hat. He crosses his eyes happily.
5.5-8.0s: final hold. The glyph 糕 stays perfectly still, centered and clearly readable. Off to the lower right, away from the strokes, the sheriff does a tiny proud salute, then the cake slice slides off his head and he catches it on his nose, tail wagging.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen narrator speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin (Taiwan standard readings, no erhua), reading exactly these syllables with clear tones: 糕、糕、蛋糕 (ㄍㄠ、ㄍㄠ、ㄉㄢˋ ㄍㄠ). Say the character twice with a short pause, then the word once, and stop. No other speech, no subtitles, no loud music; only soft cartoon whistle, skid and bonk sounds under the voice. The vocabulary word is audio only. The glyph 糕 is the only text on screen: no captions, labels, watermark, logos, clutter, flashing or strobing effects. All characters are stylized cartoon animals and toy props, no real people or realistic human figures.
